answer.reason: The verses tell of Haman's promotion, his plot against the Jews, and his hanging on his own gallows.

clauses.english: was promoted by King Ahasuerus above all the princes
clauses.quote: set his seat above all the princes that were with him

clauses.english: plotted to destroy all the Jews in the kingdom because Mordecai would not bow to him
clauses.quote: Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus

clauses.english: was hanged on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai
clauses.quote: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai.

doubts: EST 3:7 (casting Pur) and the honouring of Mordecai in EST 6 were left out as minor steps of the larger story.
